name: local-extrema
why: With `on`, extrema are the feature's own: the highest edges of the low block are 20 mm below the part's highest, and a document-global `at` would have found nothing there. Count 3 is the assertion, the fourth top edge being the inside corner against the tall block. The tall block is wider so no side faces merge: a face the unify pass makes from two features carries both names, and an `on` query reaches across such a join — measured here first, when equal widths made the tall block's top edges the low block's.
